title: Ledger Operations Standard: Late-Posting Adjustment on Pals Rewards Missed Earnings
content:
**Scope.** **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** missed-earning postings for Autoship shipments.

**Measure.** The calendar days from the shipment's processing date — the date of its Tailwise Autoship shipment charge — to the posting date.

**Standard.** The late-posting adjustment acts once on the missed-earning rate per qualifying dollar as it stands after every rate added to it:

1. more than 21 days — that rate is multiplied by 1.25;
2. more than 7 but at most 21 days — 0.5 point per dollar is added to that rate;
3. 7 days or fewer — that rate is used as it stands.

**Boundaries.**

| Days from processing to posting | Treatment |
|---|---|
| 7 | used as it stands |
| 8 | plus 0.5 |
| 21 | plus 0.5 |
| 22 | multiplied by 1.25 |

**Worked figures (hypothetical rate of 11.5 points per dollar after every addition).**

| Days late | Adjusted rate |
|---|---|
| 5 | 11.5 |
| 10 | 12.0 (11.5 plus 0.5) |
| 30 | 14.375 (11.5 multiplied by 1.25) |
